policy: Assistant-authored ES/RU/UK/DE translations for application labels and help, including audio device selection and staged Craft audio/video filters. No HTTP translation or native-linguist review. Existing nonempty seeds and CSV cells remain authoritative; no English fill into other locales. Camera and DXGI source-derived labels retain explicit unsupported/runtime limitations.
